name: unchore-defend
description: Grade a site's security headers with fixes and a badge; read logs, code or a suspicious message for the defender.
long_description: Two tools for the person protecting a system. site_check grades a public website's security headers and cookie flags (A–F), gives the one-line fix for each gap and a README badge — no key needed. defend_analyze reads a log, code, config or suspicious message and says what happened, how bad it is and what to fix first; personal data and secrets are masked before sending, and if one AI refuses the next answers (Claude → GPT → GLM → DeepSeek). defend_analyze needs your OpenRouter key or an Unchore key.

tools.name: site_check
tools.description: Grade a website's security headers (A–F) with fixes and a README badge.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter key (optional)
openrouter_api_key.description: For defend_analyze with your own OpenRouter account. Leave empty to use an Unchore key or only the site check.

unchore_token.title: Unchore key (optional)
unchore_token.description: For defend_analyze without an AI account: unchore.ai → Settings → AI → Unchore credit → New key.
